# spo_restricted_search (Data Source)

Look up an existing RestrictedSearch object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_list` (Set of String) Site URLs allowed in search when restricted.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `mode` (String) Restricted search mode: Disabled or Enabled.
